name: AERO-TUNNEL
subtitle: 2D Lattice Boltzmann Wind Tunnel & Airfoil Flight Dynamics Studio

dualAuditSignOff.technicalAuditor: PASSED (Remediated momentum exchange force vector, pause handling, glider LBM synchronization, and render loop GC)
dualAuditSignOff.productQualityAuditor: PASSED (Remediated drag clamping to zero, lift sign alignment, smoke trigger, and dual-mode polar plot)

aerodynamicsEngines.lbmSolver: D2Q9 BGK Lattice Boltzmann Method fluid dynamics with Zou-He velocity inlet, convective outflow, and free-slip wind tunnel walls
aerodynamicsEngines.forceIntegration: Momentum-exchange method on solid-fluid boundary links calculating exact sectional Lift (CL), Drag (CD), and L/D ratio with physical positive drag floor
aerodynamicsEngines.strouhalVortexShedding: Zero-crossing oscillation detection of lift fluctuations calculating physical shedding frequency f = St * U / L
aerodynamicsEngines.airfoilGenerator: Parametric NACA 4-digit airfoil geometry generator (camber m, position p, thickness t) with quarter-chord rotation

interactiveSystems.visualizer: 60fps HTML5 Canvas with turbo velocity magnitude, pressure isobar, and bipolar vorticity colormaps, plus streakline smoke particles
interactiveSystems.gliderFlightSim: Interactive flight dynamics testbed with pitch elevator control, aerodynamic stall detection, altitude tracking, and live LBM obstacle synchronization
interactiveSystems.aeroSonification: 100% procedural Web Audio turbulent boundary layer hiss, vortex shedding Strouhal hum, and stall buffet rumble
interactiveSystems.telemetryExport: CSV export of chord pressure distribution Cp(x) and polar curves, and JSON state export
